acceptance: Root cause of the AQ slowdowns identified, including the DataFusion AQ5 stall: query shape, join fan-out, or engine issue
A fix (query, generator multiplier or engine settings) chosen by the owner and landed, with measured cell durations
Spark and DataFusion tpcdi 1.0 prunes removed, and both cells green in a trunk UAT
description: #4149 (25a271c1) made FactCashBalances, FactHoldings, FactMarketHistory and FactWatches scale linearly (SF1 facts went from 275k to 6.77M rows, matching benchmark_specs.yaml). In trunk UAT 43154678095, spark tpcdi 1.0 went from 311 s to the 1200 s timeout, datafusion tpcdi 1.0 from 62 s to two timeouts, clickhouse-local 1.0 from 33 s to 255 s, and spark 0.1 from 199 s to 411 s. The join-heavy analytic queries AQ2, AQ4-AQ7 and AQ10 take 11-21 s each locally on DataFusion, and one local run stalled more than 20 minutes on AQ5 in the second pass (undiagnosed, shared machine). Spark and DataFusion tpcdi 1.0 are compatibility-pruned in the release gate until this is fixed.
